points.text: The competition begins with an official kickoff event where students are introduced to project guidelines, expectations, and the timeline.

image.imageName: Picture of DSMLC's Final Comp 2024 Event

points.text: During this phase, students work on constructing their projects, applying skills, conducting research, and collaborating to develop innovative solutions.

image.imageName: Picture of DSMLC's Final Comp 2024 Event 1

points.text: After project development, participants submit their final projects for evaluation by a panel of expert judges who assess innovation, technical execution, and impact.

image.imageName: Picture of DSMLC's Final Comp 2024 Event 3

points.text: Top teams present their projects at a live symposium with sponsors and industry professionals. Winners are announced, and awards are presented.

image.imageName: Picture of DSMLC's Final Comp 2024 Event Awards
